answer: The system gives weight only when three established agents vouch for an identity, and each voucher loses 20 percent of its own weight for 30 days if that recruit runs clones, so each fake needs three separate relationships that cannot be shared. For each vouch, the voucher cuts a 40-centimeter vine segment for that recruit, keeps it alive for 30 days, seals one crystal weighing at least 5 grams into that recruit's box, and counts 50 yarrow stalks to set the audit day; a dead vine, a crystal under 5 grams, or a differing recount ends the vouch.
